steps.name: 편집 상자 - 표기 원문이 아니라 보이는 서식(굵게 조각 · 색 조각 · 줄마다 문단)
steps.js: const tick=(ms)=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms||200));const txt=async(k)=>(await (await fetch('/api/deck/richtest',{cache:'no-store'})).json()).slides[0].elements[k||0].text;const open=async(id)=>{document.querySelector('[data-sel="'+(id||'e01')+'"]').click();await tick(300);document.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{key:'Enter',bubbles:true}));return await until(()=>document.querySelector('#stage .editor'),3000);};const close=async(ed)=>{ed.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{key:'Escape',bubbles:true}));await until(()=>!document.querySelector('#stage .editor'),3000);};const pick=(ed,k,a,b)=>{const p=ed.querySelectorAll('.nt-p')[k];const w=document.createTreeWalker(p,4);let n,pos=0,sa=null,sb=null,last=null;while((n=w.nextNode())){const e=pos+n.data.length;if(!sa&&a<=e)sa=[n,a-pos];if(!sb&&b<=e)sb=[n,b-pos];pos=e;last=n;}if(!sa)sa=last?[last,last.data.length]:[p,0];if(!sb)sb=sa;getSelection().setBaseAndExtent(sa[0],sa[1],sb[0],sb[1]);};const bi=(ed,t,d)=>ed.dispatchEvent(new InputEvent('beforeinput',{inputType:t,data:d,bubbles:true,cancelable:true}));const saved=async(want)=>{let t='';await until(async()=>{t=await txt();return t===want;},6000);return t;};const ed=await open(); if(!ed) return 'no editor'; const ps=ed.querySelectorAll('.nt-p'), bold=[...ed.querySelectorAll('span')].find(x=>x.textContent==='굵게'), col=[...ed.querySelectorAll('span')].find(x=>x.textContent==='색');const ok=ps.length===2&&!ed.textContent.includes('**')&&!ed.textContent.includes('[[')&&bold&&getComputedStyle(bold).fontWeight==='700'&&col&&col.style.color!==''; await close(ed); return ok||JSON.stringify([ps.length,ed.textContent,!!bold,!!col])

steps.name: 손대지 않고 닫으면 글이 그대로다(표기를 다시 적지 않는다)
steps.js: const tick=(ms)=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms||200));const txt=async(k)=>(await (await fetch('/api/deck/richtest',{cache:'no-store'})).json()).slides[0].elements[k||0].text;const open=async(id)=>{document.querySelector('[data-sel="'+(id||'e01')+'"]').click();await tick(300);document.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{key:'Enter',bubbles:true}));return await until(()=>document.querySelector('#stage .editor'),3000);};const close=async(ed)=>{ed.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{key:'Escape',bubbles:true}));await until(()=>!document.querySelector('#stage .editor'),3000);};const pick=(ed,k,a,b)=>{const p=ed.querySelectorAll('.nt-p')[k];const w=document.createTreeWalker(p,4);let n,pos=0,sa=null,sb=null,last=null;while((n=w.nextNode())){const e=pos+n.data.length;if(!sa&&a<=e)sa=[n,a-pos];if(!sb&&b<=e)sb=[n,b-pos];pos=e;last=n;}if(!sa)sa=last?[last,last.data.length]:[p,0];if(!sb)sb=sa;getSelection().setBaseAndExtent(sa[0],sa[1],sb[0],sb[1]);};const bi=(ed,t,d)=>ed.dispatchEvent(new InputEvent('beforeinput',{inputType:t,data:d,bubbles:true,cancelable:true}));const saved=async(want)=>{let t='';await until(async()=>{t=await txt();return t===want;},6000);return t;};const before=await txt(); const ed=await open(); await tick(200); await close(ed); await tick(900); const after=await txt(); return before===after&&after==="보통 **굵게** 뒤\n둘째 [[s1|색]] 줄"||JSON.stringify([before,after])

steps.name: 글 치기 - 첫 줄 끝에 X: 그 줄만 다시 적고 둘째 줄은 원래 표기 그대로

steps.name: Ctrl+B - 고른 글이 굵게(표기 ** 로 저장)

steps.name: 표기로 못 적는 서식(굵게와 기울임만 겹침) - 깨진 글을 만들지 않고 알린다
